proof_body:
by
  intro a ha
  refine ⟨?_, Real.tsum_exp_neg_mul_int_sq ha⟩
  have hc : 0 < Real.pi * a := by positivity
  have hg : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (Real.pi * a)⁻¹ * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num)).mul_left _
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually hg ?_
  have hfin : ({0} : Set ℤ).Finite := Set.finite_singleton 0
  filter_upwards [hfin.compl_mem_cofinite] with n hn
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hp : 0 < Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, show -Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = -(Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
  have h2 : (Real.pi * a)⁻¹ * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) = (Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by field_simp
  rw [h2]
  exact inv_anti₀ hp (by linarith)
target_source: ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → Summable (fun n : ℤ => Real.exp (-Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) ∧ ∑' n : ℤ, Real.exp (-Real.pi * a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1 / a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑' n : ℤ, Real.exp (-Real.pi / a * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
